product_from_film: A chat-driven workflow turns a YouTube interview into scheduled short clips with captions.
explains_well: The source interview, chat request, scheduling messages and final vertical clip give the workflow a visible end-to-end chain.
unclear: The film does not clearly explain which part is Clippers, which part is the chat agent and which part is the scheduling service.
scenario: Send a YouTube link, request five clips and inspect a scheduled vertical post
product_clear_basis: Full 10 s frame shows the request to clip the video and schedule the top five.
